summary: Set an Element attribute while preserving DOMString conversion, HTML name normalization, and validation.

semantics.name_validation: invalid local names throw InvalidCharacterError DOMException
semantics.name_normalization: ASCII-lowercase for HTML namespace elements in HTML documents
semantics.mutation: replace existing value or create attribute

caveats: Trusted Types can make some attribute writes host-policy-sensitive; this helper requires that behavior unobservable or separately handled.
